headline: Local Bounti Granted NYSE Extension for Market Cap Compliance
summary: Local Bounti has been granted an extension by the New York Stock Exchange to regain compliance with the $50 million market capitalization requirement.
why: NYSE listing requirements include minimum market cap thresholds; failure to comply can lead to delisting, which significantly impacts liquidity and investor access.

impacts.name: Local Bounti
impacts.why: The extension provides the company more time to avoid delisting, which is a positive development for its continued listing status.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The granting of an extension removes immediate delisting risk, which is generally perceived as a positive development for the stock's stability.
